\ednentry{
  id = {EDN-05},
  title = {A make is supported from 300 listings},
  note = {\textbf{Absorbs EDN-48} (2026-10-05): \texttt{features} is the one stage that applies the list.},
  date = {2026-09-22},
  milestone = {M1: Project Inception},
  topic = {Problem Specification, Data Preparation},
  participants = {@lukas2510},
  decision = {Only makes with at least 300 listings in the cleaned used-car data, counted after the \texttt{ES} holdout and before the split, are supported.
The \texttt{split} stage computes the list and removes no rows.
The \texttt{features} stage restricts every frame to it, the \texttt{ES} holdout included, before it builds any vocabulary.
The API rejects every other make.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item Accept all 25 makes and flag rare ones as low confidence: weak predictions for makes with a few dozen listings.
\item Filter in \texttt{split}: the split becomes lossy, and the threshold cannot be revisited without a new split.
\item Record the list and measure the metrics over every make: the gate would cover listings the API refuses with a 422.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} The dataset is skewed toward premium brands (EDN-01).
A threshold turns that limit into an explicit, testable rule.
At 300 it keeps 11 of the 25 makes and 98.6\,\% of the split listings.
Applying it in \texttt{features} makes the reported population the served one, and \texttt{train} and \texttt{evaluate} fail when that does not hold.},
  ai = {Information seeking, Alternative generation, Alternative assessment, Recommendation, Solution generation},
  response = {Accepted},
  assessment = {AI counted the listings per make after scoping and deduplication, compared thresholds of 200, 300 and 500, and recommended the threshold.
Lukas accepted because it states the brand skew openly instead of hiding it behind a warning.
AI later found that the code and two documents disagreed on where the filter belongs, raised that as a decision, and corrected its own claim that out-of-scope rows would inflate the metrics.},
  aievidence = {Claude Code sessions of 2026-09-22 (issue \#2), 2026-09-30 (issue \#35) and 2026-10-05 (issue \#63); prompt: ``How do we handle the 25 makes, many of which have very few listings?''.},
  evidence = {\href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/docs/docs/problem-spec.md}{Problem specification} section 2, ``The supported makes'' in \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/docs/docs/pipeline.md}{the pipeline docs}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/reports/analysis/served_vocabulary_results.txt}{\texttt{served\_\allowbreak{}vocabulary\_\allowbreak{}results.\allowbreak{}txt}}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/issues/2}{issue \#2}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/pull/17}{PR \#17}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/pull/71}{PR \#71}.},
